name: Pie slice callout
what: A soft glossy pie sits on a light page and pushes in slowly while a slice is cut into it: a thin line swings round from the left up to the top and widens into a deep wedge; a dot, a leader line and a text callout then appear above it, the words rising one after another; at the end everything slides down and fades out. The slice size, where it points and the words are yours.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f100 the pie pushes in slowly (x1.15, linear); f2-f20 the slice sweeps clockwise from the left (-78 degrees) round to the top while it widens to 18 degrees (the two edges on their own S-curves, fastest at f10-f11); f24 a dot appears above the slice, f25-f33 the leader is drawn up and to the right, f32-f60 along; f56 / f62 / f68 the callout words rise one after another from under a mask (exponential ease, 8.5 f) and fade in; f99-f108 everything slides down and fades out while the slice swings about 20 degrees

tracks.name: push-in
tracks.what: the whole pie scales up slowly about its centre (x1.15)

tracks.name: slice sweep
tracks.what: the slice swings clockwise from the left round to the top and widens into a wedge
tracks.easing: S-curve (measured, each edge on its own)

tracks.name: leader
tracks.what: a dot appears above the slice, a leader is drawn up and to the right and then along

tracks.name: callout words
tracks.what: the words rise one after another from under a mask and fade in

tracks.name: slide out
tracks.what: everything slides down and fades out while the slice swings away
